{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Percentage of -999 values: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).mean() * 100:.1f}%")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient (example): {df_sample_seq_max.head()}")

# Summary
print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}")"}
